svg.text: Check: Sleeping Giant, Top 6 Harugumo smoke on the west edge by cap A (G1/F1)
11 Top 6 smokes in the spot. Positions are from the one moment the batch records: when each smoke was fully laid. North-spawn teams mirrored north-south.
The smokes and who was with them
Enemies damaged, joined to the nearest allied ship
Cruiser inside in 9 of 11 (Des Moines 5, Worcester 3, Petropavlovsk 1).
Another destroyer recorded in 7 of 11, forward of the smoke in 5 (green line joins it to its smoke).
Dot = the ally nearest to each damaged enemy. Blue: the Harugumo. Violet: a ship inside the smoke.
Green: another destroyer. Grey: any other ship.
